svg.title: B / switching
svg.desc: Harness revision 13: ferrule branches at F1 LOAD, K5 power terminal 3 and K1 power terminal 3. One ferrule enters the clamp at each shared endpoint. Small AC terminals each receive one 14 AWG wire in a blue ferrule. Rail order W1, K1, W2, K5, K4, PS1, F1; sheet 07 is an enlarged GPIO connection view. Three box leads: black A01, white A08, red B04.
svg.text: B01–B05 · all RED 14 AWG · independent coil jumpers and series pump-power path
B01 = Master → K1 coil · B02 = Slave → K5 coil · B03 = series power link · B04/B05 = final output + detector
SINGLE = one conductor · SHARED = listed conductors in ONE ferrule · FITTED = as built · DATA = remaining specification

g.aria-label: B01: Red, W1 Master / K2: bottom 1st / LEFTMOST screw NO to K1 Finder: upper inner ledge screw A1
g.title: B01 · Red · W1:NO → K1:A1

g.aria-label: B02: Red, W2 Slave / K3: bottom 1st / LEFTMOST screw NO to K5 Finder: upper inner ledge screw A1
g.title: B02 · Red · W2:NO → K5:A1

g.aria-label: B03: Red, K1 Finder: bottom outer LEFT screw 2 to K5 Finder: top outer LEFT screw 1
g.title: B03 · Red · K1:2 → K5:1

g.aria-label: B04: Red, K5 Finder: bottom outer LEFT screw 2 to Inside metal box: switched-hot Wago joins red B04 lead IN to outlet-whip black
g.title: B04 · Red · K5:2 → BOX:SW

g.aria-label: B05: Red, K5 Finder: bottom outer LEFT screw 2 to K4 top outer A1 input clamp
g.title: B05 · Red · K5:2 → K4:A1

svg.text: B04 feeds pump hot; B05 senses the same switched hot.
K4 senses red A1 relative to white A2 (sheet 03).
Finder coil power: A1/A2 are distinct from 1/2
B01: W1 NO → K1 A1. B02: W2 NO → K5 A1.
Both A2 terminals receive white neutral from harness A.
1-2 switches pump hot. Terminal 3 is neutral; 4 has no wire.
The LED follows coil power; indicators need no extra wiring.
Both red wires share ONE ferrule at Finder K5 terminal 2
Detector A1 receives B05 alone: SINGLE 14.
Its A1 and A2 each receive one 14 AWG wire in one ferrule.
K5-2: one YELLOW ferrule holds both red 14 AWG wires.
WIRE BY ID · follow the end-preparation notes and assembly checkout · crossings do not connect
